layout.body:
To: miyazakisuzuki@dmail.com
From: rogersemily.branscomb.services@dmail.com
Date: 03/23/2025
Subject: Audit
Dear Mr. Suzuki,
Branscomb Technology's annual inventory audit will be performed onThursday,April 19,beginning promptly at 8:00 a.m. in the warehouse on Kramer Boulevard. All department heads like yourself are required to attend and assist with the audit process. Please ensure that all inventory logs from your department are updated and will be readily accessible two days prior to the event. Because the audit is expected to take the entire day, we will be providing lunch from Beasly Bistro for participants. Please look over the attached menu and submit your selection to Fran Paloma in the HR department. We ask that you avoid scheduling any meetings on the morning of April 20 in the event that we need additional time to complete the process.
Regards,
Emily Rogers

questions.stem: Why did Ms. Rogers send the email to Mr. Suzuki?

options.A: To assist him with an audit process
options.B: To remind him to update inventory logs every day
options.C: To inform him of an upcoming event
options.D: To request his input on how to revise a process

questions.analysis: Why did Ms. Rogers send the email to Mr. Suzuki? 原文依据：Branscomb Technology's annual inventory audit will be performed on Thursday, April 19... 布兰斯科姆技术公司年度库存审计将于 4 月 19 日周四进行…… (A) 为协助他进行审计工作 → 错误 (B) 提醒他每日更新库存记录 → 错误 (C) 告知他一项即将举行的活动 → 正确 (D) 征求他关于修改流程的意见 → 错误

questions.stem: Why should Mr. Suzuki contact Ms. Paloma?

options.A: To provide her with his meal preference
options.B: To obtain some information from the HR department
options.C: To share a list of employees who have experience with audits
options.D: To send her an updated inventory log

questions.analysis: Why should Mr. Suzuki contact Ms. Paloma? 原文依据：Please look over the attached menu and submit your selection to Fran Paloma in the HR department. 请查看附件菜单，并将你的选择提交给人力资源部的弗兰・帕洛玛。 (A) 告知她自己的用餐偏好 → 正确 (B) 从人力资源部获取信息 → 错误 (C) 分享有审计经验的员工名单 → 错误 (D) 发送更新后的库存记录 → 错误

questions.stem: What is indicated about the morning of April 20?

options.B: Mr. Suzuki might have several meetings then.
options.C: A menu might be updated then.
options.D: Employees might have free time then.

questions.analysis: What is indicated about the morning of April 20? 原文依据：We ask that you avoid scheduling any meetings on the morning of April 20 in the event that we need additional time to complete the process. 请避免在 4 月 20 日上午安排会议，以防我们需要额外时间完成工作。 (A) 审计可能会在那时继续 → 正确 (B) 铃木先生那时可能有多个会议 → 错误 (C) 菜单可能会在那时更新 → 错误 (D) 员工那时可能有空 → 错误
